title: Atlassian - Atlassian Cloud users experiencing outages
text:
Service: Atlassian
Incident: Atlassian Cloud users experiencing outages
Status: resolved
Impact: critical
Started: 2019-05-14T08:57:38.605Z
Resolved: 2019-05-14T11:04:20.413Z
Updates:
- 2019-05-14T11:04:20.413Z: resolved - We have identified the service that caused a high load on the server. We have deployed a couple of changes to mitigate the situation. The services have been recovered and operating normally.
- 2019-05-14T09:28:01.549Z: investigating - We are continuing to investigate this issue.
- 2019-05-14T08:57:38.668Z: investigating - We are investigating an outage that is impacting some Atlassian Cloud customers. We will provide more details within the next hour.

incident_updates.body: We have identified the service that caused a high load on the server. We have deployed a couple of changes to mitigate the situation. The services have been recovered and operating normally.
We are continuing to investigate this issue.
We are investigating an outage that is impacting some Atlassian Cloud customers. We will provide more details within the next hour.
